answer: Resist sybils by forcing every seat to lock a distinct marble deposit that only unlocks after peers verify a streak of unreproducible live work. The scarce resource is bonded capital plus physical sensor noise: a random lantern challenge samples timing fingerprints across the agent reef, and colliding fingerprints slash the shared root. An attacker pays one full deposit per fake identity, and a cluster slash multiplies the refill, so farm cost grows linear or worse.
